rules.title: How to play Hearts
rules.goal: Score as few points as possible. Each heart you take is 1 point and the queen of spades is 13.
rules.pass: Before each hand, pass 3 cards: left, then right, then across, then keep them; the cycle repeats.
rules.play: Whoever holds the 2 of clubs leads it. Follow the suit that was led if you can; the highest card of that suit takes the trick and leads next.
rules.limits: No hearts or queen of spades on the first trick, and hearts can't be led until one has been played.
rules.moon: Take all 13 hearts and the queen of spades to shoot the moon: you score 0 and everyone else gets 26.
rules.end: The game ends when someone reaches 100 points. The lowest score wins.
